name: assumption-log
description: Claude logs each guess it makes about what you want into a side panel. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer; tested on macOS.

name: collision-guard
description: Asks before Claude edits a file that something else changed in the last 30 minutes. Needs nothing; reads the unattended plugin's state if present.

name: context-guard
description: Warns when the conversation context gets large; opt-in auto-compact of idle sessions. Needs nothing.

name: cache-clock
description: Countdown above the prompt for the prompt cache, with a compact button. Needs the unattended and layman plugins (installed as dependencies).

name: image-shrinker
description: Shrinks big images before Claude reads them. macOS only: needs sips.

name: input-router
description: Hands large file reads and connector results to a small model first. Off by default; sends the text to a model through your own account.

name: read-fence
description: Stops Claude from opening your skill, rule and plugin folders file by file while switched on. Off by default; macOS and Linux.

name: skills-az
description: Lists your slash commands and skills A to Z when you type /. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer; tested on macOS.

name: disabled-index
description: Hints when a skill inside a plugin you switched off fits your prompt. Needs python3.
